en-us.exp_event_erav_celeb_drugged_ongoing: Tonight's itinerary changed to a 'private party' at the hotel.
en-us.exp_event_erav_celeb_drugged_result: The sake in the tatami room hits far harder than usual.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_drugged_01:
Memory comes in fragments:
An early one: kneeling in the middle of the tatami, stripped by four or five hands from every side, sake poured on her skin and licked off.
Later: lying atop somebody while another presses down from behind, filled from both ends at once, flashbulbs bursting before her eyes.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_drugged_02:
The clearest fragment of all is of her own legs opening. She doesn't remember whose order, nor why she opened them.
Shutters, laughter, urging to drink - all of it very far away.
en-us.event_erav_celeb_drugged_03:
She wakes in the hotel's bathtub. Washed clean, her hair combed smooth.
The marks over her body piece the night back together: fingermarks inside her thighs, the dried crust at the corner of her mouth, the deep bloated fullness in her lower belly.
The manager holds his phone over the tub: "Morning, girlfriend. The fans will love yesterday's footage."
